# Third-party software

CyberdyneEngine integrates the software listed here. Each dependency sits behind an engine-owned
interface, is pinned to an exact commit, and carries a permissive licence — the conditions
`thirdparty-dependencies` sets for adopting one at all.

<!-- Generated by tools/deps/attribution.py from deps/manifest.toml. Do not edit: run
     `just maintenance-deps` instead. CI fails when this file and the manifest disagree. -->

## What a build actually links

A dependency with a gating option is fetched, built and linked **only** when that option is on. A
build with the option off contains none of its code, so the notices it requires do not apply to
that build. The engine's runtime attribution reports the set for the build in hand rather than this
whole table.

| Dependency | Version | Licence | Included when | Links into |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [sdl3](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL) | 3.4.16 | Zlib | always | a shipped game |
| [doctest](https://github.com/doctest/doctest) | 2.4.12 | MIT | `CY_BUILD_TESTS` is on | the test binaries only |
| [tracy](https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy) | 0.12.2 | BSD-3-Clause | `CY_PROFILING` is on | development builds only |
| [zstd](https://github.com/facebook/zstd) | 1.5.7 | BSD-3-Clause | always | a shipped game |
| [blake3](https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3) | 1.8.7 | CC0-1.0 | always | a shipped game |

## Notices

### sdl3 3.4.16

- **Upstream**: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL
- **Pinned at**: `fa2c02bb6e21974a89ea9824bc53c9932abe5f9c` (`release-3.4.16`)
- **Licence**: Zlib
- **Licence text**: [`LICENSE.txt`](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/blob/fa2c02bb6e21974a89ea9824bc53c9932abe5f9c/LICENSE.txt), and
  `LICENSE.txt` at the root of the fetched source in any configured build tree
- **Behind**: cy::Platform and cy::DisplayServer, implemented in platform/desktop-sdl3/
- **Included when**: always
- **Linked into**: a shipped game
- **Why integrated rather than built**: Window, event, and gamepad coverage across three desktop platforms, plus the controller database, which is maintenance rather than differentiation.

### doctest 2.4.12

- **Upstream**: https://github.com/doctest/doctest
- **Pinned at**: `1da23a3e8119ec5cce4f9388e91b065e20bf06f5` (`v2.4.12`)
- **Licence**: MIT
- **Licence text**: [`LICENSE.txt`](https://github.com/doctest/doctest/blob/1da23a3e8119ec5cce4f9388e91b065e20bf06f5/LICENSE.txt), and
  `LICENSE.txt` at the root of the fetched source in any configured build tree
- **Behind**: the CY_TEST_CASE wrapper in tests/, so the framework is replaceable
- **Included when**: `CY_BUILD_TESTS` is on
- **Linked into**: the test binaries only
- **Why integrated rather than built**: A test framework is not differentiating, and doctest compiles roughly an order of magnitude faster than the alternative — see design.md section 5.

### tracy 0.12.2

- **Upstream**: https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy
- **Pinned at**: `c556831ddc6fe26d2fce01c14c97205a9dad46d5` (`v0.12.2`)
- **Licence**: BSD-3-Clause
- **Licence text**: [`LICENSE`](https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy/blob/c556831ddc6fe26d2fce01c14c97205a9dad46d5/LICENSE), and
  `LICENSE` at the root of the fetched source in any configured build tree
- **Behind**: a backend of the engine's own trace in src/core/diagnostics/, never a second timeline beside it
- **Included when**: `CY_PROFILING` is on
- **Linked into**: development builds only
- **Why integrated rather than built**: An excellent frame profiler and viewer. The engine owns the trace schema and publishes into Tracy as one export of it.

### zstd 1.5.7

- **Upstream**: https://github.com/facebook/zstd
- **Pinned at**: `ac66b19e6bd6b83238bf008eecc1298105298532` (`v1.5.7`)
- **Licence**: BSD-3-Clause
- **Licence text**: [`LICENSE`](https://github.com/facebook/zstd/blob/ac66b19e6bd6b83238bf008eecc1298105298532/LICENSE), and
  `LICENSE` at the root of the fetched source in any configured build tree
- **Behind**: the engine's compression interface in src/core/, which the trace writer and the package format consume
- **Included when**: always
- **Linked into**: a shipped game
- **Why integrated rather than built**: Best-in-class ratio at the speeds the trace writer and the package format need. Offered under BSD-3-Clause or GPL-2.0 and taken under BSD-3-Clause.

### blake3 1.8.7

- **Upstream**: https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3
- **Pinned at**: `f3149ec5bb5449af877ba20377a11008ff499fa2` (`1.8.7`)
- **Licence**: CC0-1.0
- **Licence text**: [`LICENSE_CC0`](https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3/blob/f3149ec5bb5449af877ba20377a11008ff499fa2/LICENSE_CC0), and
  `LICENSE_CC0` at the root of the fetched source in any configured build tree
- **Behind**: the engine's hashing interface in src/core/, beneath derivation keys and content addressing
- **Included when**: always
- **Linked into**: a shipped game
- **Why integrated rather than built**: Cryptographic code is never hand-rolled, and the build graph's derivation keys need a fast tree hash. Offered under CC0-1.0, Apache-2.0 or Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception and taken under CC0-1.0.
